Offline evaluation runs against a curated, versioned dataset with declared expectations (`EvalCase` in `src/aire/runner/dataset.py`). It is reproducible, cheap to re-run, and comparable across versions, but it is only as good as the dataset. Online evaluation judges live traffic, which covers the long tail of real inputs but cannot be replayed exactly and usually relies on sampled human review or proxies. AIRE implements offline evaluation deliberately: the demo's {{ds.n_cases}}-case JSONL set is fixed, hashed into the run manifest (`dataset_sha256`), and identical for every version, which is what makes the regression reports meaningful.
